text: Simmering serves as an essential phase in cooking since it enables tastes to merge and deepen with time. Achieve this by applying low heat within a ventilated space until the liquid reaches a steady simmer before transferring the pot off the burner. The primary objective is fostering flavor development while avoiding burning or the loss of subtle taste profiles. After the process begins, adjust the seasoning last; introduce salt, pepper, herbs, or spices to balance the profile and highlight inherent sweetness.
